prae-jūrātĭo , ōnis, f.,
I.a previous taking of an oath which others then repeat: “praejurationes facere dicuntur hi, qui ante alios conceptis verbis jurant: post quos eadem verba jurantes tantummodo dicunt: Idem in me,” Fest. p. 224 Müll.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
